messages:
maria.t: Heads-up: after enabling identity-binding enforcement in the router, we're seeing a small spike in 401/403s for old SDK clients. Most failures show up as \"no-origin-claim\" from the auth proxy.

samira: Do we have sampling of the failing token IDs? Curious if it's a specific SDK version or tokens minted before a schema change.

maria.t: Pulled a sample:
```
[2026-03-20T09:11:02Z] req=zx12 auth=API_KEY key=ak_9abc result=403 reason=\"no-origin-claim\" route=identity-bound
[2026-03-20T09:11:02Z] req=zx13 auth=API_KEY key=ak_9abc fallback=org-default route=billing result=200
```

lucas: That matches: auth service returns origin_project=null for tokens minted before v2.4. We added a strict check in router that bails on missing project. Maybe too aggressive for rollout.

samira: Agreed. Two options: 1) roll back enforcement and re-run migration to add claims, or 2) implement a graceful fallback in router that maps to `billing:<org>` and tags the request so Console/quota reflect the fallback. Product prefers option 2 so existing traffic doesn't break.

maria.t: Proposal for router change:
```
identity_binding:
  enforce: true
  on_missing: soft_map
  soft_map_header: X-Effective-Origin
  metric_label: auth.mapping=soft_map
  sticky_ttl: 20s
```

lucas: If we soft_map, we should also emit a histogram `auth.mapping.latency` and increment a counter `auth.mapping.missing` with labels key_prefix and sdk_version (if present) so we can pinpoint issuers.

samira: Telemetry wants two new dimensions: `auth_effective_project` and `auth_resolution` (values: origin, billing_mapped, denied). Also add `auth_sdk` to traces so Optimize can recommend token rotation to customers.

csm-ops: Console impact: customers are getting billed to org pool and CS is getting tickets. We need an explicit column in the quota dashboard showing \"Effective Project\" and a tooltip: \"If original token had no project claim, requests may be billed to org default.\" Also a per-org alert: if billing_mapped fraction > 0.2% over 10m, page the CS on-call.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled: router/v3.softmap -> 0.5% traffic at 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z. :satellite:

maria.t: Canary plan: enable soft_map, collect `auth.mapping.missing` for 1h, compare by key prefix and sdk_version. If any key_prefix shows >2% mapped, open ENG ticket to contact accounts. If overall fallback >1% escalate to product.

lucas: I'll add unit/e2e tests and a schema-version guard: if token.schema < 2, mark `sdk_version` from token metadata.

samira: Console work: I'll file ENG-1290 to add the Effective Project column + hover copy and ENG-1291 for the alert rule. Docs: add migration note about token schema v2.4+.

maria.t: One more: ensure we log sampled request IDs for each soft_map event and persist them for 7 days to correlate with token issuance. Also limit PII in logs.

csm-ops: Approved. Please include a short blurb in the customer incident feed if we see sustained mapping for any tenant.

maria.t: Thanks all. Lucas/samira pair on PRs. I'll run the canary playbook and announce rollback criteria (if mapped fraction > 5% in first hour).
